A `case` that doesn't end with `break`, `return`, `throw` or `continue` keeps going into the code of the next `case`. A forgotten `break` runs code for a value it wasn't written for, and nothing fails at that line.

If you want the fallthrough, say so in a comment that contains `falls through` right before the next `case`. Several `case` labels in a row that share one body are allowed.

This rule is on by default.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

On by default as an error. To turn it off:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"no-fallthrough" = "off" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default. The ones that are commented out have no default.

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"no-fallthrough" = ["error", {
  # commentPattern = <string>,
  allowEmptyCase = false,
  reportUnusedFallthroughComment = false,
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":
    publish(post);
  case "published":
    notify(post);
    break;
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":
    publish(post);
    break;
  case "published":
    notify(post);
    break;
}
```

{/* good */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":
    publish(post);
  // falls through
  case "published":
  case "pinned":
    notify(post);
    break;
}
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commentPattern` | `"falls?\\s?through"`, ignoring case | A regular expression for the comment that allows a fallthrough. It replaces the default. |
| `allowEmptyCase` | `false` | Allow an empty `case` with a blank line before the next one. |
| `reportUnusedFallthroughComment` | `false` | Report a fallthrough comment after a `case` that can't fall through. |

{/* good {"options": [{"commentPattern": "break omitted"}]} */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":
    publish(post);
  // break omitted on purpose
  case "published":
    notify(post);
}
```

An empty `case` followed by a blank line looks like its body was deleted, so it's reported unless you set `allowEmptyCase`:

{/* bad */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":

  case "published":
    notify(post);
}
```

{/* good {"options": [{"allowEmptyCase": true}]} */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":

  case "published":
    notify(post);
}
```

With `reportUnusedFallthroughComment`, a comment that's no longer true is reported:

{/* bad {"options": [{"reportUnusedFallthroughComment": true}]} */}
```js
switch (post.status) {
  case "draft":
    publish(post);
    break;
  // falls through
  case "published":
    notify(post);
}
```
